segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You grab the thick velvet ribbon dangling from the bottom of the twenty-foot gift box display and give it everything you've got!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The bottom box slips out, and the entire festive mountain groans.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: the commander rattles, waving his arms.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A shower of colossal, brightly wrapped boxes collapses across the gym like a bright red tidal wave! Giant velvet bows, Styrofoam packing peanuts, and heavy cardboard boxes crash down on the soldiers, sweeping them off their wooden feet.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The soldiers slide across the polished gym floor like bowling pins, their legs spinning in the air.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Using the tumbling boxes as stepping stones, you sprint across the floor, smash your shoulder against the emergency push-bar, and burst through the heavy metal doors into the blinding snow!
